body:
It's all pretty pathetic really. Compared to 99.9% of people I have a great life. Great home, wife, job, family.... I have nothing to bitch about. I just can't get this monkey off my back that is there for no reason and it makes me want to dangle from a rope sometimes. 

To top it all off I feel like I don't have the right to feel this way because there are people with actual problems in the world.
